description: This file contains the implementation of ContentItemDisplayManager, a class responsible for rendering and editing ContentItem objects within OrchardCore CMS. It manages shape creation, display types, stereotypes, and invokes handlers for building display and editor shapes.

classes.name: ContentItemDisplayManager
classes.description: A class that manages the display and editing of ContentItem objects, including shape creation, handling stereotypes, display types, and invoking display handlers.

methods.name: BuildDisplayAsync
methods.description: Builds the display shape for a ContentItem based on display type and stereotype, setting properties and alternates accordingly.

methods.name: BuildEditorAsync
methods.description: Builds the editor shape for a ContentItem, preparing it for editing with appropriate alternates.

methods.name: UpdateEditorAsync
methods.description: Updates the editor shape for a ContentItem, processing submitted data and invoking handlers for update logic.
